objective: The token-refresh endpoint rejects an expired refresh token instead of issuing a new access token.

acceptance_criteria.check: refresh() returns a 401 when isExpired(token) is true
refresh() still issues an access token for a non-expired token

context.claim: isExpired() compares token.exp against the current epoch seconds
the refresh route is reached only after bearer auth on /token/refresh
the ticket asks for parity with the access-token expiry guard shipped last release
